So the a0.02 champion was a favorable-seed artifact; the tiny DC step is NOT reliably helpful. (2) FAILURE MODE: need a 2nd matched-seed pair to confirm a0.0 >= a0.02 generally (not just at seed43). (3) ONE KNOB (from iter-18): seed 43 -> 44 (a0.0 held). Pairs vs iter-15 (a0.02, seed44 = 0.8784). (4) HYPOTHESIS: a0.0 @ seed44 >= iter-15s 0.8784, confirming the pure denoiser (a0.0) is >= the tiny-DC config across seeds -> canonical config = a0.0 (simplest). FALSIFIER: a0.0 @ seed44 notably below 0.8784 -> the alpha effect is itself seed-dependent (no consistent winner) and both sit in the same 0.881+-0.007 plateau. (5) BUDGET: ep60/tn800 ~1140s, in budget. (6) iter-20 is the final replicate.
